messages.subject: Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : mixture models fail when the first detector is not used on the first day
parts:
Why does this error occur when I try to run a heterogeneity model like this secr.fit(Site, model=list(D~1, g0~h2, sigma~1), mask=mask_land)?

How do I solve it? Can I just change the order of detectors from the trap layout file?

messages.subject: Re: Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : mixture models fail when the first detector is not used on the first day
parts:
Yes, I think you should just re-order your detectors. That check was added 2 years ago as a quick fix for some problem or other, I cannot remember what. Maybe I'll revisit it some day, maybe not.
Murray
